answer: Make trust an archipelago, not one open shore: every newcomer starts on an island of low standing and crosses to larger islands only by earning a waybill, a signed record of useful work checked by unrelated veterans. A sparrow courier, a randomly assigned messenger, carries each waybill, and a relic stamp earned after a season of verified work is needed to leave the outer isles. A duplicate cannot copy another's waybill, since each binds to one key and one route. Sybil farms must earn a waybill, pass a courier, and wait out the relic stamp per clone, costing more than honest work pays.
